name: APOLUNE

about.statement: I shape the product where design, motion, and code meet, bringing it to life with essential animation
about.bio: Apolune is an end-to-end production house and creative collective founded by cinematographer Ansel Tan and director Britney Kam. We work across mediums, from narrative film to commercial to music video, to tell STORIES FROM THE FAR POINT, and to help your visions come to life. We handle every step of the production process in-house, from ideation to shooting to even original scoring. Get in touch with us today; let's see what we can create together.

faq.q: What kind of projects do you work on?
faq.a: We make narrative films, music videos, commercials, documentaries, and original theatre and publishing projects. We also collaborate with artists and organizations to shape an idea into a finished piece.

faq.q: Can you help develop an idea from the beginning?
faq.a: Yes. We can join at the earliest concept stage and help with story, creative direction, budgeting, scheduling, production, post, colour, and original scoring. If you already have a clear brief, we can start there too.

faq.q: Where are you based, and where do you work?
faq.a: Apolune is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. We work locally and travel for projects when the story or production calls for it.

faq.q: What does working with Apolune look like?
faq.a: We begin with a conversation about your goals, audience, timeline, and budget. From there, we build a clear plan and keep you involved through production and delivery, with one in-house team guiding the work from start to finish.

faq.q: How do I get a quote or discuss a project?
faq.a: Use the contact form or write to hello@apolune.net with a short description of the project, your timing, and any materials you already have. We’ll follow up to talk through scope and next steps.
